_archetype.name: IGT Triple Double Diamond (Hot Roll base reels, Hot Roll bonus slot replaced with Blank)
_archetype.source: Wizard of Odds reverse-engineered reel mapping (https://wizardofodds.com/games/slots/hot-roll/)
_archetype.confidence: medium-high — expert reverse-engineering, not IGT official PAR sheet
_archetype.modifications_from_archetype: Position 13 (Hot Roll bonus trigger) replaced with Blank on all 3 reels — M1 has no bonus feature so that slot becomes filler. All other symbols / positions preserved. See mode_N/weights.json for per-mode weight variations (IGT-style RTP variants via virtual-reel re-mapping).

_invariants: 22 physical stops per reel; shared symbol layout (position -> symbol) is byte-identical across all modes — only per-mode weights vary.
Blank alternation is NOT enforced (real TDD has consecutive blanks at pos 12/13/14 where Hot Roll was replaced). M1 is exempt from test_alternation_invariant.
Reel 1/2/3 have INDEPENDENT symbol sequences (classic IGT convention — each reel's symbol order is tuned for its own dramatic role).
Hot Roll bonus slot -> Blank replacement at pos 13 on all 3 reels is the ONLY deviation from Wizard of Odds Hot Roll archetype.

_symbol_role.Diamond1: Double Diamond (2x wild) — substitutes any symbol except Cherry and self; multiplier 2x
_symbol_role.Diamond2: Triple Diamond (3x wild) — substitutes any symbol except Cherry and self; multiplier 3x
